title: Forehead
description: Hold the phone sideways against your forehead and let the room shout at you. You cannot see the word — everyone else can. Tilt down when you get it, tilt up to skip, or just tap: the right half is a hit, the left half a pass. Five decks of fifty cards each, a clock that speeds the music up as it runs out, and a round score that goes to the global board.
